method: Exact piecewise visibility integration from local step keys; emission rates and lifespans are static on all 12 emitters. rate × lifespan is a steady-state live particle / ribbon-segment estimate, not a draw-call or GPU measurement. Visibility uses None interpolation with default 1 when the interval contains no keys, matching the pinned viewer semantics.
baselineFindingsBeforeApprovedReduction: Display Float has 2 continuously active PRE2 (67 and 68), not all 8: 80/s and approximately 98 steady-state particles.
Walk has 2 continuously active PRE2 (69 and 70): 80/s and approximately 48 steady-state particles.
Display Cast has no active PRE2; all 4 ribbons remain active.
Float, Walk and Cast each retain 4 ribbons: 65 segments/s and approximately 50.5 live segments at steady state.
PRE2 74 using Flame4 is the only emitter restricted to egg/morph states. PRE2 71/72/73 are birth/death/morph bursts, not continuous idle emitters.

Geoset 0 uses Yellow_Glow3 additive layer alpha 0.54, with 15 billboard groups / 30 triangles and geoset visibility 1 in Float, Walk and Cast. It is omitted from the body-only previews and can materially alter the visible color/brightness.
limitations: Native texture pixels were not loaded; names and modulation values alone do not prove exact displayed colors.
No particles/ribbons were rendered, no Warcraft III runtime or frame-rate testing performed.
Steady-state estimates do not model warm-up, emitter history across sequence transitions, particle tails, occlusion, screen coverage, overdraw or burst overlap beyond sampled visibility.
Ribbon segment rate/count is a distinct quantity from PRE2 particle count; do not claim their sum is draw calls.
Existing emitted particles can remain alive after visibility turns off; instantaneous state estimates are not a transient particle simulation.
